newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 13.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on February 13. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Suharto has asked the Indonesian media not to imitate the way foreign press cover the events in the country. He said foreign press usually dramatised events.

Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad said the appreciation of the U.S. dollar against the yen had helped reduce Indonesia's foreign debt in dollar terms but threatened the competitiveness of the country's exports, especially to Japan.

The Indonesian air force will not release the two French pilots and their planes now detained at the Syamsuddin Noor airport in Banjarmasin, south Kalimantan, before they are tried for landing without proper documents.

Secretary-general of the National Commission of Human Rights Baharuddin Lopa has arrived in Pontianak, capital of west Kalimantan, to collect information about the ethnic riots which have rocked the province since late December.
